data.title: Add integration tests for in-memory service
data.description: The in-memory service for Fleece issues appears to only have a limited number of unit tests. Add further testing to this library to ensure that the integration of the queue and service work well. Use mock data to ensure that the tests all function when using issue JSONL files live in a .fleece folder on disk. It also appears that the service queues individual write operations - this shouldn't be necessary as all of the data should be deserialized at once, and as such it would be expected that the queue should operate more as a debouncing system that only deserializes after the latest change rather than a queue of operations. Please confirm whether this intuition is correct.
